installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git jq unzip file make gcc g++ python3 python3-dev libtool
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD:-0}" != "1" ] && [ "${USER_UPLOAD:-false}" != "true" ] && [ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS:-}" ]; then
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        echo "Existing Git repository found; fetching updates."
        git fetch --all --prune
        if [ -n "${BRANCH:-}" ]; then
            git checkout "${BRANCH}"
            git pull --ff-only origin "${BRANCH}"
        else
            git pull --ff-only
        fi
    elif [ -z "$(find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ]; then
        ASKPASS="$(mktemp)"
        cleanup_askpass() { rm -f -- "${ASKPASS}"; }
        trap cleanup_askpass EXIT
        cat > "${ASKPASS}" <<'ASKPASS_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
case "$1" in
    *sername*) printf '%s\n' "${GIT_USERNAME:-}" ;;
    *) printf '%s\n' "${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN:-}" ;;
esac
ASKPASS_EOF
        chmod 0700 "${ASKPASS}"
        export GIT_ASKPASS="${ASKPASS}" GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
        if [ -n "${BRANCH:-}" ]; then
            git clone --depth 1 --single-branch --branch "${BRANCH}" -- "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
        else
            git clone --depth 1 -- "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
        fi
        cleanup_askpass
        trap - EXIT
    else
        echo "ERROR: /mnt/server is not empty and is not a Git repository."
        exit 10
    fi
else
    echo "Skipping Git clone (user upload mode or no repository configured)."
fi

if [ "${ENABLE_YTDLP:-1}" = "1" ]; then
    mkdir -p .local/bin .config/yt-dlp
    YTDLP_TMP="$(mktemp -d)"
    cleanup_ytdlp() { rm -rf -- "${YTDLP_TMP}"; }
    trap cleanup_ytdlp EXIT
    curl -fL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 15 https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp -o "${YTDLP_TMP}/yt-dlp"
    curl -fL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 15 https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/SHA2-256SUMS -o "${YTDLP_TMP}/SHA2-256SUMS"
    (cd "${YTDLP_TMP}" && grep ' yt-dlp$' SHA2-256SUMS | sha256sum -c -)
    install -m 0755 "${YTDLP_TMP}/yt-dlp" .local/bin/yt-dlp
    if [ ! -e .config/yt-dlp/config ]; then
        printf '%s\n' '--js-runtimes node' > .config/yt-dlp/config
    fi
    cleanup_ytdlp
    trap - EXIT
fi

corepack enable || true
if [ "${INSTALL_DEPENDENCIES:-1}" = "1" ] && [ -f package.json ]; then
    PM="${PACKAGE_MANAGER:-auto}"
    if [ "${PM}" = "auto" ]; then
        if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then PM=pnpm; elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then PM=yarn; else PM=npm; fi
    fi
    case "${PM}" in
        pnpm) corepack pnpm install ;;
        yarn) corepack yarn install ;;
        npm) npm install ;;
        *) echo "ERROR: Unsupported package manager: ${PM}"; exit 2 ;;
    esac
fi

echo "Installation complete."
